name: Voyager frameset

editorial.verdict: The road-like 415 mm chainstays, T800 construction, 850 g size-54 claim, 45C clearance and current official-store ¥7,800 starting price make this a strong lightweight all-road option when the selected cockpit package is confirmed.
strengths: T800 construction and manufacturer-reported 190 N/mm bottom-bracket result
Five-size official geometry with short 415 mm chainstays
caveats: The current CNY 7,800 listing is a starting price across cockpit-included and cockpit-excluded options; confirm the selected package before checkout
The 190 N/mm result is manufacturer-authored and lacks an independent published protocol
Slim lightweight tubes are not a full deep-section aero-gravel shell

purchase_route: Exact official INCOLOR Taobao item 943286238552 or a mainland dealer listed by the manufacturer
included: integrated AEROWAV gravel cockpit only when the selected listing option explicitly includes it
